title: populus kangdingensis var. tibetica
intro: Populus kangdingensis var. tibetica, commonly known as the Tibetan poplar, is a deciduous tree species native to the Tibetan Plateau. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Populus kangdingensis var. tibetica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever, relieving cough, and soothing respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
